summary: Defined workflow schema and persistence layer for visual editor state. Created TypeScript interfaces (WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection, Workflow, CreateWorkflowInput, UpdateWorkflowInput) in src/types/workflow.ts. Implemented WorkflowPersistenceService with full CRUD operations (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, deleteWorkflowPermanently) using Neo4j Cypher queries following existing codebase patterns. Added schema initialization with unique constraints and composite indexes for query performance. Exported types and service from index modules. All 23 new tests pass and all 1000 existing tests remain passing.
